message.zh: 新版采用模块化架构，新增三档生产利润与稀有产物派生估值、排行榜名次徽章、战斗 Buff、资产历史、采购与完整升级链任务排序、DPS/HPS/承伤统计、重复脚本提醒，以及游戏内意见反馈；建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: The modular rewrite adds three production-profit valuations with derived rare-drop values, leaderboard rank badges, battle buffs, asset history, procurement with full upgrade-chain task sorting, DPS/HPS/damage-taken tracking, duplicate-script warnings, and in-game feedback. Update on Greasy Fork.
